ModMetaData.name: Vanilla Tune-Up: Fixes & Tweaks
ModMetaData.author: ifchen0
ModMetaData.description:
A collection of small fixes and optional tweaks for vanilla RimWorld. Every part can be turned on or off in the mod settings (restart required). Fixes are on by default, tweaks are off.
Fixes: - Faction leaders: fixes the "Faction leader for X is null" error. - History graph: removes the History tab lag in long-running colonies. - Right-click menu: stops the stutter while a right-click menu is open on the map. - Trade setup: removes the freeze when a trade window opens with many items (and with Auto Seller). - Mechs in sieges: fixes the error spam when a siege includes mechs added by other mods. - Food policy during mental breaks: wardens no longer bring restricted food to a prisoner having a mental break. - Tend bleeding prisoners first: wardens skip feeding while a prisoner is bleeding. - Prisoner food delivery keeps up: when prisoners get hungry, one trip brings food for everyone in the cell who needs it. - Stuck on the way to bed after being downed: a pawn knocked down on the way to bed walks on to it after getting up, instead of standing still until it collapses. - Official translation fixes: fixes quest text shown as ERR and generated text left in English that a translation file cannot override (currently Traditional Chinese).
Tweaks: - Xenogerm queue: a bill-style queue for the gene assembler (Biotech). - Mute labor and birth sounds (Biotech). - Remove fog of war: reveals the map on generation or load, except fogged areas where revealing would trigger something. - Faction icons in caravan lists: shows the faction icon of guests, prisoners and other non-colony pawns. - Caravan encounters stay on the current map: caravan event dialogs open without switching to the world map. - Pin resources: left-click a resource in the categorized resource list to keep it shown while its category is collapsed, even at 0. - Nutrient paste stock: a "dispense until you have X" target for nutrient paste dispensers, shared by the whole map. - Break up social fights (experimental): anyone who sees a social fight nearby may step in to stop it. - Food policy for new prisoners: new prisoners get the food policy you pick. - Hybrid children keep a matching xenotype: a Hybrid child whose genes closely match one heritable xenotype gets that xenotype (Biotech). - Tell faction colors apart: factions with nearly identical colors are nudged apart on load. - Drag to reorder: right-drag to reorder the bottom bar, architect categories, buildings and command buttons. - Compact colonist bar: the colonist bar shrinks while the mouse is away and expands on hover.
Safe to add to or remove from an existing save. Load after Harmony.
This mod was developed with the help of AI coding tools (Claude Code). Full source code is included in the Source folder for review.
